reviews.comment: Dr. Ghose made the class very easy to follow; it's the lab you should watch out for, and unfortunately, my TA is a tough grader. Exams are chill, EASY group projects, slides are long but she highlights important stuff, attendance not mandatory but extra credit!

She is an amazing lecturer and person all around. Her tests were very straightforward, and she never gave too much work. She clearly wants her students to understand the material and succeed. She is also very caring and funny. Would absolutely recommend her!

She wants you to understand biology and frequently asks for questions during class to help anyone who doesn't understand. She clearly tells you what you need to know for each exam and give extra credit, so go to class. She's also just a very kind person!

I LOVEEE Dr. Ghose!!! She's genuinely so funny, and her lectures are very easy to comprehend. She has few "group days" before exams, but they're really helpful! There are lots of opportunities for extra credit, like iClicker quizzes in class. She really knows her stuff and gives plenty of real-world applications. She's amazing!!

I love love Professor Ghose. She lectures so well and everything is so clear and concise to understand. I'm on track to end with a 96 for the semester. Go to class because she does I-Clickers to get up to 20 points extra credit by the end of the semester. Exams are like the practice exams she gives and labs are genuinely not difficult. 10/10 prof

She is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about her students. In class she is a great lecturer and only gives I clicker questions at the end of every unit and they are strictly extra credit points. Go to her office hours if it all possible she is great at explaining things.

Plenty of time to write your essays. I heard bad experience but only from TA graders so try your luck. Clear expectations and grading. Never had to revise my essays. Overall, minimal effort and it's an easier A than expected.

Two essays, which you have plenty of time to work on. Extra credit opportunity provided. Reasonable grader and clear expectations. Put in some effort, and you'll achieve the grade you desire. Easy A for bio majors.
Amazing lectures, study=easy test, and attendance is extra credit. She's so sweet and a great teacher! Would recommend!
AMAZING TEACHER!!! She is so knowledgeable and so girl boss. I wish she taught Bio 112 because she is such an amazing professor omg

She is an absolute joy to be around and one of the most evidently intelligent profs I've had! You can do well in this class and learn surface level information, or you can learn topics that go over the scope of Biology 111 and be fascinated with this class (and do well, of course). She has a lot of extra credit built in!

If you can take Dr. Ghose, PLEASE DO. She is an amazing professor and her lectures make so much sense. She clearly states what will be on the exams and has reviews that are very similar to the actual exams. Attendance is not mandatory but she does have in-class extra credit quizzes so make sure you go!

Dr. Ghose is an INCREDIBLE prof. Her lectures are engaging, and some classes are solely dedicated to exam review, where she clearly states everything you need to know. Her slides also clearly highlight/emphasize which facts are most important. Hardly any homework, extra credit, and straightforward exams. I highly recommend taking her class!

I think Ghose might be my favorite professor yet. Her lectures were easy to follow and she made sure to break down complex concepts. Her tests are easy, as long as you review her slides cuz most of the questions come from the slides. Textbook is encouraged but not needed, I got an A without touching the textbook once.

MY QUEEN. If you want an easy A take her exams are SO easy same as practice so many in class extra credits. dont be like me &skip. She's such a funny person kind of witty . Go to her office hours to get to know her a bit better she is so lovely. If you want to ask her a million questions shes so nice about it and doesnt make you feel dumb TAKE HER
Tests were very easy and slides were well-made to be understood

Great prof! Very nice and really good lecturer- she adds plenty of cat memes to her slides. Tests are very easy, she tells you in class exactly what will be on them and gives you a practice exam just like the test. Lab exams are hard but not worth much for your grade. 2% extra credit by iclicker

Dr. Ghose is one of the best and most caring professors at TAMU! She is an amazing lecturer and her exams are very fair and come straight from the slides. She does a wonderful job at explaining difficult topics and is very helpful and accessible outside of class. Go to class and office hours to do well on the exams. I would 100% recommend her!

Her exams are very easy, quite literally just memorization and some are very similar to the review. She lectures well, if anything it was the lab section that was just a tad bit hard depending on which TA you get. Just read the slides and if you want extra credit go to class for the iClicker questions.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a really caring professor who takes time to get to know her students. She explains every concept clearly and always emphasizes what will be tested, which makes things feel fair. Her exams are very similar to the practice ones, and sometimes even have the same questions. She also gives plenty of extra credit through iClicker. I love her!

Dr. Ghose is super kind and emphasizes exactly what will be tested over. She cares about the material and does her best to make lectures fun. The practice exams are just like the real thing and she gives lots of extra credit via iclickers. Highly recommend

GREAT! Honestly I never paid attention or took notes in class. only went bc she gives iclicker bonus sometimes (not that much though so you could get away just not going). Took notes from her slides & Studied few days right before each exam (super similar to practice exam) and it worked out. Take her!!
Great teacher highly recommend

(BIOL 402). She's the GOAT. She makes it very clear on how she will grade, and it is up to you to earn the grade. If one of your papers gets a low grade, she is very accessible to have a meeting with and discuss how you can fix it. It's perfect for a writing class, as the instructions are crystal clear, she is accessible, and I improved my writing.

Dr. Ghose is the best professor I have ever taken. You can tell she is very passionate about teaching. She wants her students to succeed and makes sure to answer any questions you have. Her tests are lecture heavy but if you take notes and study you will be fine. I attended lots of SIs which helped me. Would definitely take her again I LOVED her.

An amazing professor who takes the time during lectures for students to fully understand the material. She constantly cracks jokes and is excellent at making students participate in class by asking questions and connecting to lecture material. There are free iclicker points that are "pop-quizes" which is all extra credit. Show up and pay attention

Dr. Ghose is a delight in class, she's very kind and speaks clearly. She's very accessible outside class and assigned 31 extra credit points tied to class attendance, so even though attendance is not mandatory I would heavily recommend attending nonetheless. Her lectures are thorough and she clearly states what will and will not be on the exams

A really good option for BIO 111. She offers 30 extra credit points randomly during lectures throughout the semester using iClicker towards your grade which makes it almost impossible to do poorly if you just attend class. Her exams are easy if you just study her PowerPoint slides really well. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ghose clearly knows what she is talking about, and her lectures are sprinkled with lots of memes. By going to SI and studying her lecture slides I was able to do pretty well on her tests because biology is all about memorizing terms and cellular systems. I would recommend this prof.
